name: Smartfood White Cheddar Popcorn (Kernel Hull WARNING)
whyItWorks: Unlike extruded corn puffs, Smartfood is real air-popped whole kernel corn. Every popped cluster contains rigid, sharp brown pericarp hulls that do not dissolve in stomach acid and easily lodge in narrowed Crohn's strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. Choose hull-free PopCorners or Pirate's Booty instead.
